title: Weave of the Shroud linen as data

band_orientation.value: bands run lengthwise, parallel to the warp; the twill diagonal reverses across the width

rule.text: i = floor(u_m * warp_per_m) counts warp threads across the width; j = floor(v_m * weft_per_m) counts weft picks along the length; p = i mod 80; phase = p if p <= 40 else 80 - p; the weft is on top where (phase + j) mod 4 == 0, so the warp floats over three picks and under one.
rule.legend: W = warp on top, f = weft on top

tile.orientation: s across the width (warp count), t along the length (weft count); PNG row 0 is t = 1
tile.normal_encoding: slope space: rgb = 0.5 + 0.5 * (-dh/ds, -dh/dt, 1) / 2.5, slopes clipped at 2.5; normalize after sampling (glTF and X3D renderers do). Mipmaps then average slopes, so the weave fades to flat with distance instead of striping.
tile.profile: elliptical yarn sections at 0.9 of the pitch; a thread passing over sits a full yarn height up, under it 0.45 of it; cosine transitions between crossings
